# Studio Fab

> Free browser-based parametric design tool for laser cutting. Generates production-ready SVG and DXF files. No account required, runs entirely in the browser.

URL: https://studio-poetics.github.io/fab/
Source: https://github.com/Studio-Poetics/fab
License: See LICENSE file
Tech: Svelte 5, TypeScript, Vite, Three.js

## What it does

Studio Fab lets you design laser-cut parts by entering numbers — dimensions, material thickness, kerf — and instantly see the flat-cut panels laid out, ready to export. It is parametric: change any value and everything updates in real time.

## Modules

### Box Generator
Creates flat-cut panels for 6 box types with finger joints:
- Open Tray — bottomless box, good for organizers and trays
- Closed Box — 6-sided sealed box
- Hinged Lid — box with an attached hinged top panel
- Slider Lid — box with a lid that slides into grooves
- Lift-Off Lid — box with a separate press-fit lid
- Multi-Section — box divided into compartments by internal dividers

Controls: width, height, depth, material thickness, kerf compensation, finger joint count, tab style.
Export: SVG (flat cut layout) and DXF R12 (for LightBurn, RDWorks, Inkscape, Illustrator).

### Electronics Enclosure Designer
Designs project enclosures for electronics with standard connector cutouts on any face. Faces: Front, Back, Left, Right, Top, Bottom. Connector types available:
- USB-C, USB-A, Micro-USB
- HDMI, Mini-HDMI, DisplayPort
- XLR (3-pin audio)
- D-Sub DB9 and DB25 (serial / VGA)
- 3.5mm audio jack, 6.35mm jack
- IEC C14 power inlet
- Mounting screw holes
- Custom rectangle (any size)

Includes a 3D assembly preview using Three.js with actual CSG holes cut through panels.

### Gear Generator
Designs involute spur gears, rack-and-pinion, and planetary gearsets. Parameters: module (tooth size), number of teeth, pressure angle, face width, bore hole diameter. Animates the gear mesh in the browser. Exports SVG for laser cutting.

### Living Hinge Generator
Creates laser-cut flex hinge patterns (kerf cuts) that allow rigid sheet material to bend. Patterns: kerf (straight cuts), wave, cross. Provides physics analysis: minimum bend radius, spring-back estimate. Exports cut pattern as SVG/DXF.

### Kinematic Mechanism Designer
Designs and animates 2D mechanisms:
- Crank-Slider: converts rotary motion to linear reciprocating motion
- Scotch Yoke: produces pure sinusoidal linear motion
Exports linkage geometry as SVG for laser cutting and assembly.

## Export formats

- **SVG**: Scalable vector graphics. Opens in Inkscape, Adobe Illustrator, Affinity Designer, any browser.
- **DXF R12**: AutoCAD Drawing Exchange Format. Opens in LightBurn, RDWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, Rhino, QCAD.

Kerf compensation is applied before export — the cut lines are already adjusted for the laser beam width.
